newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ayer Hitam Tin sells land for 60 mln rgt.
newsitem.headline: Ayer Hitam Tin sells land for 60 mln rgt.

text.p: Ayer Hitam Tin Dredging Malaysia Bhd announced on Wednesday it was planning to sell two pieces of land totalling 52.07 acres (20 hectares) for 60.5 million ringgit.

It said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange the land was being sold to its wholly owned subsidiary, Pembinaan AHT Sdn Bhd, which in turn will be sold to a Malaysian citizen, Taharudin Ahmad.
Taharudin will acquire the entire equity of one million shares for 1.1 million ringgit and simultaneously Pembinaan AHT will buy the Ayer Hitam lands for 59.40 million ringgit.
The company said the sale of the land would generate an an extraordinary gain of 27.30 million ringgit.
"The disposal also would (increase) .... earnings per share of the group from a loss of two cents recorded for the six months ended December 31, 1996 to a positive 44 cents," the statement said.
